description: List recently saved items. Use only when the user asks about recent saves.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent items to return.

location.description: Optional Inbox or Knowledge Base location filter.

sourceType.description: Optional source type filter: manual, extension, rss, newsletter, inbox, or import. Array or comma-separated string. Use sourceType:['manual','extension'] to return only the user's own saves (manual and extension saves). Defaults to all types.

name: kb_recent
title: Recent saved items
